Meta has announced two new AI models, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, featuring 'active memory' and 'active focus' capabilities.

These models aim to improve task persistence and conversational continuity across legal, medical, and coding domains.

Muse Wonder is available via API, while Muse Wonder Full is accessible through monthly subscription tiers.
